STEP 2 - Ruler: The white square plate is roughly 26 cm across its width. Vessel area ≈ 26 × 26 × 0.85 (square corners) ≈ 575 cm^2, using a round-equivalent of ~27 cm diameter area ≈ 530 cm^2. I use 530 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: (a) boiled/steamed cauliflower florets, (b) cooked eggplant pieces with some golden browned bits (likely fried in a little oil).

STEP 4 - Area: Cauliflower covers ~22% of the plate. Eggplant with browned bits covers ~12%. Total food ≈ 34% (about 180 cm^2).

- Cauliflower: 117 cm^2 × 2.5 cm ≈ 290 ml (loose florets, tall pile)
- Eggplant: 64 cm^2 × 1.5 cm ≈ 95 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:

- Eggplant: 95 ml × 0.7 ≈ 65 g (cooked, with some oil absorbed)

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Cauliflower, cooked: 175 g × 23 kcal/100 g ≈ 40 kcal
- Eggplant, cooked/fried: 65 g × 90 kcal/100 g ≈ 59 kcal (includes absorbed oil)

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A moderate side-sized portion of vegetables covering about a third of a dinner plate, roughly 240 g total and ~100 kcal, is plausible for what is visible.
